verdict.rationale: The evidence documents in-person acceptance options: Solo/Go readers, Tap to Pay, Cloud API and Reader SDKs. None of it covers merchant sign-up, the approval or KYC process or its timeline, or ordering hardware from a dashboard. Without that, the end-to-end onboarding journey and the 'same week' timeline are unevidenced, and in-person payment capability alone is adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week
